text:
Alex: Weekend pet therapy thread! Meet Gizmo, my sugar glider who insists on attending standups by curling into my sleeve. pic: https://i.imgur.com/gizmo_cuddle.jpg :squirrel:
Priya: sugar glider in a sleeve = peak morale. also that face is legally adorable :heart_eyes:
Marco: GIF of Gizmo gliding across my laptop when I tried to code: https://i.imgur.com/gizmo_glide.gif :sunglasses:
Jen: dog tax incoming: Miso the shiba claiming the comfiest chair as her throne. pic: https://i.imgur.com/miso_throne.jpg :dog2:
OpsBot: reminder: please sign the Office Pet Waiver and upload vaccine docs before bringing animals onsite: https://hr.internal/pet-waiver :memo:
Alex: noted @OpsBot. Gizmo is up-to-date on checkups and only snacks on tiny fruit bits. He demands a tiny conference corner with dim lights :zzz:
Priya: poll: anyone okay with Gizmo visiting the office next Wednesday? react :raised_hand: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no
Marco: raising hand. will bring a soft travel pouch and a sound machine to keep him zen :musical_note:
Lila: bringing a tiny rug and some lubricant for enthusiasm (just kidding, treats only) :blush:
Jen: caption contest: "When you open the calendar invite and it's actually nap time" my vote :joy:
Marco: "Approved: naps in lieu of status updates" runner-up
Alex: LOL. also Gizmo has a weird habit of approving PR titles by head-tilt. volunteering to demo if allowed :sparkles:
Priya: pledging to help with on-site supervision. also can we make a Slack emoji of Gizmo's suspicious blink? :eyes:
OpsBot: allergy reminder: if you have pet allergies, please annotate your desk profile before Wednesday so seating can be arranged: https://hr.internal/desk-profiles :bell:
